items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: No, the only two I remember was Black, three rather, was Black Benny, Red Happy, and Kimball, trumpet player. I mean he was their trumpet player too, believe me.

ctx.x: You remember who was in Robichaux's band at the Liried?
No, the only two I remember was Black, three rather, was Black Benny, Red Happy, and Kimball, trumpet player. I mean he was their trumpet player too, believe me.
Well who came first, Black Benny or Red Happy?
